summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary 424B5 pricing supplement for $1,000-per-note Senior Autocallable Leveraged Barrier Notes due October 3, 2031, linked to the State Street Utilities Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLU), issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program. The notes pay no interest, autocall on September 30, 2027 at $1,200 per note if XLU is at or above the Call Value, offer 175.00% upside participation, and expose holders to 1-for-1 downside below the Threshold Value, with up to 100% principal loss. Senior unsecured obligations; aggregate principal blank. This is a routine structured-note shelf takedown, not a special situation.
